decision_question: 这条母婴 TikTok 高表现候选是否值得转译成一个受事实与安全边界约束的 Momcozy 单变量测试？

observations.text: ARK by KOMI reports that the TikTok video gained approximately 8.7 million views.
The source page credits @kaymurphy13 via ARK Media and classifies the item as Parenting & Kids.
The source summary describes moving the baby, high chair and plate into a shower and cleaning them in the same action.
Likes, comments, shares, completion, paid or organic distribution and account-size context are not reported on the source page.
The original TikTok post locator, collection and deduplication method, ranking denominator and source-use rights are unresolved.
No independently captured product CTA or conversion event is available for this source-limited brief.

inferences.text: The leading bounded hypothesis is that proof-demonstration through visible task compression may support attention and sharing.
inferences.alternative_explanation: Creator distribution, editorial selection, novelty, cross-platform curation or an unobserved trend may account for the performance signal.

inferences.text: Experience-pov may be a secondary signal because the reported material is a mobile-shot family routine rather than a specification-led product explanation.
inferences.alternative_explanation: The perceived authenticity may be attributable to the creator identity and distribution context rather than the visual point of view.
